away.summary: The Rangers extended their win streak to four-straight games, the longest-active streak in the NHL, and have won four of their first five games. Igor Shesterkin has notched his third-straight win this season, allowing two or fewer goals in all four games played. Cole Beaudoin made his NHL debut in the most recent game.

home.summary: The Capitals kicked off their home portion of the 2026-27 regular season slate when they hosted the Pittsburgh Penguins. Defenseman Matt Roy departed Saturday's game with the Lightning with a lower body injury and has not practiced with the team these last two days, but coach Spencer Carbery stopped short of ruling him out of Wednesday's game, calling him day-to-day. Dylan McIlrath would slot in for Roy in the lineup if the latter is unable to play.
